headline: Daily Fundamental View:November 16, 2026

highlights: Of this, Rs 20,970 Cr pertains to orders under the JV/GIC platform (Gemstar Infra Pte Ltd, in which Genus holds a 26% stake), executed through SPV entities and sub-contracted to the company.
This compares with Rs 25,173 Cr as of 31s Mar’26 and Rs 24,020 Cr as of 30th Jun’26, as execution continues to draw down the order book.
At ~4.4x TTM revenue, the order book provides comfortable revenue visibility.

However, a pickup in fresh order inflows will be key to sustaining growth momentum beyond the current execution cycle. • Margins Hold Steady Sequentially, Revenue Moderates: Revenue stood at Rs 1,133 Cr (down 1%/17% YoY/QoQ), reflecting a softer execution quarter.
valuation: Current Valuation: 15x on our Sep’28 EPS Estimate Current TP: Rs 315/share (Earlier: Rs 335/share) Recommendation: We revise our rating on the stock from BUY to HOLD.

International markets and VECV’s expanding presence across EVs and SCVs are expected to support long-term growth Current Valuation: We value RE’s standalone business at 31x FY28E EPS (Earlier: Unchanged) and VECV at 12x EV/EBITDA on FY28E EBITDA (Earlier: Unchanged).

Phase-I capacity expansion, expected to be completed by early Q3FY27, will enhance capacity by 20-30%, supporting the current market opportunity of 5 Lc MHCV units and the long-term Rs 5,000 Cr revenue target by 2030.
watch: However, a pickup in fresh order inflows will be key to sustaining growth momentum beyond the current execution cycle. • Margins Hold Steady Sequentially, Revenue Moderates: Revenue stood at Rs 1,133 Cr (down 1%/17% YoY/QoQ), reflecting a softer execution quarter.

However, the pace of fresh awards remains key to order inflows. • Buyback Approved: The Board, at its meeting on 26th Oct’26, approved a buyback of up to 48 Lc equity shares (1.56% of paid-up equity capital) for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs 148 Cr, at a maximum price of Rs 312/share.
